summary: Iteration 19: Tested 'Copy Opening Balance from Year-End Closing' feature. All 12 backend API tests pass + full frontend E2E flow verified with Playwright. Delhi illaka (id: 69c78cf96781e1fb0d95f0dd) has a year-end closing on 2024-03-31, and the new feature correctly surfaces the closing banner and pre-fills opening balance amounts.

feature_tests.closing_history_contains_2024_03_31: PASS — Delhi illaka has closing on 2024-03-31
feature_tests.closing_balances_required_fields: PASS — Each item has account_head_id, balance, group_type
feature_tests.closing_balances_excludes_income_expense: PASS — No income/expense group_type items returned
feature_tests.closing_balances_excludes_zero_balance: PASS — All returned items have balance > 0
feature_tests.closing_balances_404_for_missing_date: PASS — 404 returned for closing_date=2025-03-31 (no closing exists)
feature_tests.modal_opens_correctly: PASS — Opening Balance modal opens via data-testid=opening-balance-btn
feature_tests.modal_shows_year_end_banner: PASS — 'Year-End Closing found' banner displayed with date 2024-03-31
feature_tests.copy_prefills_amounts: PASS — Loans Portfolio field pre-filled with 3600 after clicking Copy
feature_tests.date_updated_to_april1: PASS — Date field updates to 2024-04-01 after clicking Copy
feature_tests.auto_calc_updates: PASS — Auto-calculated section shows Total Assets (Dr) = ₹3,600 after copy
feature_tests.success_toast_shown: PASS — Toast 'Copied balances from 2024-03-31 closing' displayed

critical_code_review_comments: Backend closing-balances endpoint correctly queries journal entries up to and including closing_date — logic is sound
Frontend handleCopyFromClosing correctly maps account_head_id to amounts state and sets date to closing+1 day (April 1)
Closing history is fetched via GET /api/loans/year-end-closing/history — correctly reuses the existing Gyal loan structure as the closing signal
NOTE: accounts.py is now 1287 lines (far beyond 700 line limit) — should be split into modules (accounts_opening.py, accounts_bid.py, accounts_entries.py, accounts_expense.py)
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Delhi illaka year-end closing on 2024-03-31 was pre-existing.
